def Sdots():
    a=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    return [(r,c) for r in range(len(a)) for c in range(len(a[r])) if a[r][c]=='S' and r>10]
print("before:",Sdots())
for (r,c) in [(37,18),(54,49),(55,14)]:
    before=Sdots()
    res=action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    after=Sdots()
    removed=set(before)-set(after)
    print(f"click({r},{c}) changed={res.get('board_changed')} removed={sorted(removed)} remaining={len(after)}")
    if res.get('done') or res.get('level_completed') or res.get('game_over') or res.get('run_complete'):
        print("STATE:",res.get('done'),res.get('level_completed'),res.get('game_over'),res.get('run_complete')); break
print("final S:",Sdots(),"step",current_frame.step)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
